content:
Ravi: FYI our GPU pool onboarding in eu-west-2 is failing — the provisioning script is hitting a bunch of 429s when creating security group rules. Anyone seen this pattern today?
Marta: Yep saw similar around 09:04 UTC, errors look like AWS RequestLimitExceeded / Throttling on EC2/AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress calls.
Ken: Oof. Is this per-account SG create rate or per-region?
Ravi: Error log snippet: `bot:authorize_sg() -> Throttling: Rate exceeded for security-group rule creation (RequestLimitExceeded)`. Happening during a burst of 80 node launches for a Dedicated capacity scale-up.
Priya: That matches the limit we hit previously when we tried per-node SGs. AWS has an api throttling window for security group modifications.
Sam: current workaround was to serialize rule creation in the script with exponential backoff, but that slows ramp and breaks SLA for fast onboarding.
Marta: Can we pre-provision a shared SG template for the pool and attach it to instances instead of creating per-node rules? That should reduce create calls by ~90%.
Ravi: Good short-term idea. We're still blocked for this rollout — can someone open a support case with AWS for increased rate limit for ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress in eu-west-2? Tag as P2.
Ken: Opening case now. Case: 1234567890 (internal). Request: increase API rate for security-group rule updates for account redwood-prod in eu-west-2 during 09–11 UTC to support Dedicated onboarding.
ops-bot: deploybot: Noted. Automated throttling mitigation enabled: provisioning script will apply jitter + 200ms base backoff.
Priya: Also adding a short-term circuit: if SG rule create fails after 5 attempts, attach a pre-warmed fallback SG and continue. We'll record that as a technical debt item.
Oncall: Please update the runbook step "sg_throttle_response" to include opening the AWS case and fallback SG attach. I hit this last month too.
Sam: Cost note — shared SG approach increases blast radius but saves ~2 hours per large rollout. We'll document the risk in the ticket.
Marta: Long-term we should change the provisioning pattern: group nodes by subnet and reuse SGs, and batch rule changes into fewer API calls where possible. Also ask infra-research to measure rate limits by region so we can pre-warm.
Ravi: Thanks. Owners: Ken (AWS case), Priya (script patch + fallback SG), Marta (runbook + design). Repro timeline: 09:01 first error, 09:06 rate hits steady, 09:12 ops-bot mitigation turned on.
Ken: AWS response: provisional increase approved for 48h while they review. They suggested adding a limit increase for "SecurityGroupRuleRate" and monitoring CloudWatchExceedance metrics.
Ravi: Sweet. After the change we should re-run the onboarding stress test. Can someone schedule a 10-node ramp test tomorrow morning in eu-west-2?
Sam: Scheduled 09:30 UTC. I'll post results. :thumbsup:
Marta: Added checklist to runbook and flagged follow-up epics: infra/sg-rate-mitigation and infra/prewarm-sg.
Ravi: Closing loop here — thanks everyone.
